Title: Generally Available: Azure Site Recovery Update Rollup 77 – March 2025

Body.Content:
This update provides the following improvements for the latest version of Azure Site Recovery components.  

Mobility Service –  

 

  1. New Linux OS distros for Azure to Azure: 
    1. OEL 8.10 
    2. Alma 8 
    3. Alma 9 
    4. Ubuntu 2404 


  1. Added support for kernels in Linux OS for Azure to Azure: 
    1. Debian 11 
    2. Debian 12 
    3. SLES 12 
    4. SLES 15  

This update also provides improvement and bug fixes. 

Learn more.
